Task1.description: Set up FastAPI Backend with RDS Connectivity
Task1.task_description: Implement a complete FastAPI-based backend service with MySQL/RDS integration, following best practices and including proper testing
Task1.details:
Core Technologies:
- Python and FastAPI for API development
- MySQL with Amazon RDS for data storage
- RESTful API principles for external interactions
- Comprehensive testing framework implementation
- CI/CD pipeline configuration

Task1SubTask1.description: Set up basic project structure and dependencies
Task1SubTask1.details:
Create initial project structure including:
- requirements.txt for dependencies
- main.py for FastAPI application
- config.py for configuration management
- .env.example for environment variables
- .gitignore for version control
Implement proper directory structure following FastAPI best practices

Task1SubTask2.description: Implement database configuration and connection management
Task1SubTask2.details:
Create database connection management using SQLAlchemy:
- Configure MySQL/RDS connection settings
- Implement connection pooling
- Set up environment-based configuration
- Create database initialization and session management

Task1SubTask3.details:
Implement data layer:
- SQLAlchemy models for database tables
- Pydantic schemas for request/response validation
- Model relationships and constraints
- Data validation rules

Task1SubTask4.description: Implement API routes and CRUD operations
Task1SubTask4.details:
Create RESTful API endpoints:
- Route handlers for CRUD operations
- Request/response validation
- Error handling middleware
- API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger

Task1SubTask5.details:
Completed unit tests for:
- BaseModel functionality
- Schema validation and model-schema conversion
- BaseCRUDService operations
Tests include proper error handling, validation, and edge cases.

Task1SubTask6.details:
Completed integration tests including:
- Test infrastructure setup with FastAPI TestClient
- API endpoint tests for all CRUD operations
- Error scenario testing
- Database interaction verification
- Test utilities and helper functions
